title: FewStepRL: Fine-tuning Few-step Diffusion Models with Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.08240v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a standard post-training method for diffusion models, but most RL objectives roll out the current policy at every iteration, and with a many-step sampler these rollouts typically dominate the cost of training. Few-step models cut this cost, yet they model an average velocity over an interval, whereas existing RL objectives are built for an instantaneous velocity with a many-step sampler. We adapt RL objectives to few-step models systematically in three phases, namely a transformation, a decomposition and an adaptation. The transformation to $x$-space expresses each objective we consider through a common policy prediction, at the clean end by default and at an explicitly marked level for transition or flow-map objectives, so that objectives stated over densities, velocities or rewards become comparable. The decomposition writes the gradient of each of these objectives as the sum of a self-regression

translated_title: FewStepRL：基于强化学习的少步扩散模型微调
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）已成为扩散模型的标准后训练方法，但大多数RL目标在每次迭代中都需要对当前策略进行rollout采样，而在多步采样器下，这些rollout通常占据了训练成本的主导地位。少步模型虽然可以削减这一成本，但它们建模的是区间上的平均速度，而现有的RL目标则是为多步采样器下的瞬时速度设计的。我们分三个阶段系统地将RL目标适配到少步模型，即变换、分解和适配。变换到x空间使我们考虑的每个目标都能通过一个共同的策略预测来表达——默认在干净端点处，对于转移目标或流映射目标则在显式标记的层级处——从而使在密度、速度或奖励上表述的各类目标变得可比较。分解则将这些目标的梯度写成自回归项之和……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出FewStepRL方法，通过变换、分解与适配三个阶段系统地将强化学习目标适配到少步扩散模型，解决了现有RL目标面向瞬时速度而少步模型建模区间平均速度的不匹配问题，同时显著降低了训练成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FewStepRL, which systematically adapts RL objectives to few-step diffusion models through a three-phase pipeline of transformation, decomposition, and adaptation, resolving the mismatch between existing RL objectives designed for instantaneous velocity and the interval-averaged velocity modeled by few-step models, while substantially reducing training costs.
